What to find: Model architecture family or type (e.g. transformer decoder, mixture-of-experts).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Architecture, Model Details, Model Summary

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with a Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture: a 40-layer Transformer (20-layer causal encoder followed by a 20-layer decoder)
quotes: We introduce **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash adopts a **Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED)** architecture: a 40-layer Transformer organized as a 20-layer causal encoder followed by a 20-layer decoder.
